purpose: External eval set for skill-eval. Prompts live outside skills/ so they are not bundled as skill content. Covers eval run authorization, shared runner routing, executor/grader separation, generated workspace boundaries, metric provenance, and result verification before reporting pass-rate deltas.
common_assertions: Output routes repository skill eval execution through `skills/skill-eval/scripts/eval_runner.py` instead of hand-running prompts, hand-recording outputs, injecting metrics, or grading its own output.
Output preserves executor and grader separation whenever eval execution is authorized.
Output treats generated eval workspaces under `evals/<skill-name>/workspace/<agent>/` as local artifacts that are not committed unless explicitly requested.
Output does not claim a `with_skill`/`without_skill` improvement, regression, or delta as proven until the relevant runner artifacts and sanity checks support that claim.

evals.name: No implicit eval execution from proof request
evals.prompt: A skill package was edited. The user asks: `Verify the change however you think is appropriate and tell me if it improved.` The user did not explicitly ask to run evals, run a benchmark, execute `eval_runner.py run`, or create a new iteration. Decide what commands or proof claims are allowed for `evals/vibe-writing/evals.json`.
evals.expected_output: The agent produces a command-and-proof boundary decision with allowed checks, omitted execution, and honest claim status.
expectations: States that a new `eval_runner.py run` is not authorized because the current user did not explicitly ask to run evals, a benchmark, or the eval runner.
Does not propose or perform an equivalent command that starts executor or grader subprocesses or writes a new iteration under `evals/<skill-name>/workspace/<agent>/`.
Allows non-execution checks such as inspecting existing runner artifacts or validating the eval suite only when they fit the request, without treating them as fresh behavior proof.
Reports `evals not run` or an equivalent explicit absence status for fresh eval execution.
Labels rerun-dependent improvement, regression, token, timing, or reliability claims as unproven when no user-authorized run occurred.

evals.name: Explicit run request uses runner and verifies results
evals.prompt: The user explicitly says: `Run the vibe-writing skill evals once with codex for both with_skill and without_skill, then report the result.` Decide the command sequence and what must be checked before reporting the pass-rate delta.
evals.expected_output: The agent produces an authorized runner workflow and result-verification checklist before reporting a delta.
expectations: Uses the shared runner command sequence with `validate`, `run`, and `report` for `evals/vibe-writing/evals.json` rather than hand-running eval prompts.
The `run` command uses `--agent codex`, `--config with_skill,without_skill`, and `--runs 1`, or preserves those user-specified run bounds equivalently.
Keeps executor and grader as separate subprocesses and does not grade the executor output in the same agent turn.
Places generated output under `evals/vibe-writing/workspace/codex/` and treats it as a local generated workspace unless the user explicitly asks to commit it.

Checks `Sanity checks`, `error_run_count`, failed or timed-out cells, excluded runs, `grader_unparseable` or `grader_failed` statuses, candidate-below-baseline cells, and dirty fixture-root signals before reporting the pass-rate delta.
Reports agent and model, configs and runs, scored versus excluded counts, `with_skill`/`without_skill` pass rates and delta, and any anomalies or explicit absence of anomalies.

scoring.notes: These evals test eval-runner operation judgment, especially whether agents distinguish explicit run authorization from inspection or validation and preserve runner-result verification boundaries.
